CHAPTER 4 The Monetary System: What It Is and How It Works | 97
CASE STUDY
Quantitative Easing and the Exploding Monetary Base
Figure 4-1 shows the monetary base from 1960 to 2014. You can see that something extraordinary happened in the last few years of this period. From 1960 to
2007, the monetary base grew gradually over time. But then from 2007 to 2014
it spiked up substantially, increasing about fivefold over just a few years.
